dashboard.prophetDescription: Prophet projects (MAF pipeline scope). List, search and manage projects for the current product.
dashboard.prophetCreateActiveHint: Inactive projects are hidden from the default list until reactivated.
dashboard.prophetCreatePageDescription: Define a name, optional description and expected date for the MAF project.
dashboard.prophetCancelConfirmDescription: Any information you entered will be lost.
dashboard.prophetCreateSubmitConfirmDescription: It will appear in the list. You can change it later.
dashboard.prophetRestoreConfirmDescription: The project will be active again and visible in default lists.
dashboard.prophetEditDescription: Update the project name, description and expected date.
dashboard.prophetEditMissingId: No project was selected. Open edit from the list.
dashboard.prophetEditSubmitConfirmDescription: The project will be updated with the values you entered.
dashboard.prophetRefineDescription: Describe what should change. A new artifact version is created; preserved steps are copied from the latest version. Run the pipeline on that version to execute only from the detected first affected step onward.
dashboard.prophetRefinePlaceholder: e.g. Update the domain model to add a Billing aggregate; keep market research as-is.
dashboard.prophetRefineHint: The backend estimates the first pipeline step to re-run (0 = file/chunking). You can run the pipeline on the new version when ready.
dashboard.prophetRefineSuccess: Version {version} created. First step to re-run (0-based index): {step}.
dashboard.prophetInputsDescription: Upload one file at a time: PDF, Word (.doc / .docx), Markdown, plain text, JSON, code, etc. (max 10 MB). Files are stored securely and listed below.
dashboard.prophetInputsDeleteConfirmDescription: The file will be removed from storage and cannot be recovered.
dashboard.prophetArtifactsDescription: When a pipeline run completes, architecture, class and flow diagrams, and documentation are added here as Markdown files with fixed names starting with "pipeline-" (updated on each completion). You can also upload your own reports (.md, max 5 MB each). Preview supports GitHub-style Markdown and Mermaid diagrams.
dashboard.prophetArtifactsDeleteConfirmDescription: The file will be removed from storage and cannot be recovered.
dashboard.prophetArtifactsViewError: Could not load file for preview.
dashboard.prophetHtmlPocsDescription: Web and Mobile POCs in one place: shows the latest pipeline output when present; upload HTML to override it (max 15 MB, .html or .htm). View opens in a window.
dashboard.prophetHtmlPocEmptySlot: No POC uploaded for this channel.
dashboard.prophetHtmlPocPopupBlocked: Allow pop-ups for this site to preview the POC.
dashboard.prophetHtmlPocReplaceDescription: A file is already uploaded for this channel. Uploading will replace it.
dashboard.prophetHtmlPocInvalidFile: Use .html or .htm only, up to 15 MB.
dashboard.prophetHtmlPocDeleteDescription: The file will be deleted from storage.
dashboard.prophetPipelineDescription: Interactive pipeline: preview step states and actions before wiring the live API.
dashboard.prophetPipelineMockBanner: Mock data — the scenario selector and Continue / Run again / Rewind only show toasts. Preview for completed steps uses local samples.
dashboard.prophetPipelineApiBanner: Live API — status of the project’s latest artifact version. Preview for completed steps reads that version’s artifacts and files.
dashboard.prophetPipelineNoVersions: This project has no artifact versions yet.
dashboard.prophetPipelinePreviewError: Could not load this step’s preview.
dashboard.prophetPipelinePreviewHint: Intermediate output can only be previewed when the step completed successfully.
dashboard.prophetPipelinePreviewHelpTitle: Only available for successfully completed steps.
dashboard.prophetPipelineRetryStepTitle: Clears this step’s output and runs it immediately (POST …/steps/retry).
dashboard.prophetPipelineRewindStepTitle: Moves the pipeline to this step and stays paused until you press Continue (POST …/steps/rewind).
dashboard.prophetPipelineDiagramHint: Columns adjust to the available width (minimum card size). On very narrow screens you may scroll a row sideways. With API data source, per-step Retry/Rewind call Prophet; with Mock, they show toasts only.
dashboard.prophetPipelineActionsHint: Run again re-executes that step immediately (Paused, Failed, or Completed). Rewind here only moves the pointer to that step and leaves the pipeline Paused — then use Continue or Run pipeline as needed.
dashboard.prophetPipelineBreakpointPauseTitle: While Interactive is on, stop auto-continue before this step runs so you can inspect output or use Retry/Rewind. Press Continue to resume auto-continue until the next pause or the end.
dashboard.prophetPipelineLiveActionsHint: Run pipeline: restarts from step 1 when status is Idle, Failed, or Completed (clears prior outputs). Interactive: after each step the client calls Continue automatically until the run finishes (toggle anytime except while Running). With Interactive on, use “Pause for review” on steps where you want to stop for manual Continue, Retry, or Rewind; after Continue, auto-continue runs again until the next pause or completion. When Paused with Interactive off, use Continue manually. Rewind here is also available when Completed — the pipeline becomes Paused at that step. Add source files under the project Inputs tab.
dashboard.prophetPipelineArtifactsPanelDescription: All JSONB artifacts stored for this artifact version (generic viewer).
dashboard.prophetPipelineArtifactsEmpty: No JSON artifacts for this version yet.
dashboard.requestFailed: Request failed. Check your connection and try again.
